blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Justin delos Santos fired a two-under-par 68 and Bianca Pagdanganan returned a 67 as the Filipino aces put themselves in the individual mix while towing the Philippine men’s and women’s squads well into the heat of the team battle as golf action in the Asian Games got off the ground at Kasugai Golf Club’s East course in Nagoya, Japan, on Wednesday. Delos Santos overcame some tournament jitters once he was on the course, shooting four birdies against two bogeys to be three shots behind joint leaders Wang Wei-hsuan […]...
